name: TextBox 3
text:
The Coaching Bottleneck
• Coaches are distracted by manually writing tallies, losing valuable face-time with players.
• No immediate statistics can be calculated during the critical 11-point break or between sets.
• Paper records are easily lost, unorganized, and fail to track player progress over time.
• Existing commercial tech options are locked behind heavy subscription and equipment walls.
textPreview: The Coaching Bottleneck | • Coaches are distracted by manually writing tallies, losing valuable face-time with players. | • No immediate ...

name: Rounded Rectangle 4
text:
THE MANUAL CHAOS WE ARE ELIMINATING:
❌ Tally Marks on Paper
   Messy handwriting that coaches must count and calculate by hand after games.
❌ Zero Real-Time Action
   Insights arrive too late (usually days after a match) to adjust ongoing game strategies.
❌ Fragile & Lost Data
   Physical binders that pile up and offer no historical progress search capability.

DATABASE REQUIREMENTS
Database model connects coaching records
The schema must preserve coach ownership, player context, match rallies, shot notation and training repetitions.
textPreview: The schema must preserve coach ownership, player context, match rallies, shot notation and training repetitions.

text: Ownership chain

User > CoachProfile > Player
Each coach owns their player records and session context.
textPreview: User > CoachProfile > Player | Each coach owns their player records and session context.

text: Match structure

Match > MatchSet > Rally > ShotRecord
Every point sequence stays connected to the match and player.
textPreview: Match > MatchSet > Rally > ShotRecord | Every point sequence stays connected to the match and player.

text: Training structure

TrainingSession > TrainingRep
Drill target, player, shot focus and repetition result are saved together.
textPreview: TrainingSession > TrainingRep | Drill target, player, shot focus and repetition result are saved together.

text: Reference data
ShotType links live shots and training reps so analysis uses a consistent badminton vocabulary.
textPreview: ShotType links live shots and training reps so analysis uses a consistent badminton vocabulary.

text: History behavior
Match and training records support soft delete so coach history can be hidden without losing data integrity.
textPreview: Match and training records support soft delete so coach history can be hidden without losing data integrity.

text: Reporting base
Dashboard and export reports pull from Match, Rally, ShotRecord, TrainingSession and TrainingRep.
textPreview: Dashboard and export reports pull from Match, Rally, ShotRecord, TrainingSession and TrainingRep.

text: Key tables: User, AuthSession, CoachProfile, Player, Match, MatchSet, Rally, ShotRecord, ShotType, TrainingSession and TrainingRep.
